dataset.name: Standalone 6-DoF stair-climbing simulation
dataset.note: Synthetic trajectory and sensors. Semantic labels are produced by the reliability-aware cluster readout on the corrected NYU Depth V2 pilot subset. This is not ROS-Gazebo and not a real robot run.

simulation.process_model: x_t = x_{t-1} + u_t + N(0, Q(C_t)); diagonal Q
simulation.metrics_definition: axis RMSE per state component; overall position RMSE = sqrt(mean(||p_est - p_gt||^2)); orientation RMSE = sqrt(mean(||angle_error||^2))
